say:3:1421803002:1.text: This underground city is absolutely magnificent!
say:3:1421803002:1.source_cn: 难以想象，地底深处竟然有这样壮观的王城！

say:4:1421803003:1.text: A mysterious underground kingdom, the lost dwarven ruins, and the dragon soaring from the depths of the earth...
say:4:1421803003:1.source_cn: 神秘的地下王国，失落的矮人遗迹，由地底深处飞出的龙……

say:5:1421803004:1.text: We thought we were the quickest to act, but many of our peers still got here ahead of us...
say:5:1421803004:1.source_cn: 我们本以为自己是最早动身的学者，却还是有不少同事抢在了...

say:6:1421803005:1.text: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!
say:6:1421803005:1.source_cn: 不瞒您说，与梅林相关的传闻也在萨洛克兰满天飞呢！
say:6:1421803005:1.male: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!
say:6:1421803005:1.female: By the way, we've heard a lot about your remarkable feat in Sal'thorin!

say:7:1421803006:1.text: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?
say:7:1421803006:1.source_cn: 趁此机会我一定要问问您那些奇闻和壮举是不是真的！
say:7:1421803006:1.male: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?
say:7:1421803006:1.female: Now's my chance to ask you about it! Are those stories true?

say:8:1421803007:1.text: Hold your horses, Melissa. I know you're excited, but we need to stay focused on our priorities.
say:8:1421803007:1.source_cn: 等等梅丽莎，我理解你的激动，但别忘记我们的研究优先级。

say:9:1421803008:1.text: "The Study of Ancient Biomes" trumps everything!

choice_prompt:10:1421803008.text: "The Study of Ancient Biomes" trumps everything!

say:11:1421803009:1.text: Let me explain—out of all the things to study here, Gali has decided to study the subterranean ecosystem first.
say:11:1421803009:1.source_cn: 让我来解释吧……因为这里能研究的课题实在太多了，伽利想...

say:12:1421803010:1.text: He was inspired by a highly popular academic work by Fink, our senior at the Evergreen Conservatory. It's called "The Study of Ancient Biomes."
say:12:1421803010:1.source_cn: 这一想法得益于冬青学会的芬克前辈极为畅销的学术新著——...

say:13:1421803011:1.text: Gali's been so into this book lately that I'd call it borderline obsession...
say:13:1421803011:1.source_cn: 伽利最近很喜爱这本书，不，应该说是痴迷……

say:14:1421803012:1.text: Fink's masterpiece has inspired me! I'll make Sal'thorin's unique subterranean ecosystem the starting point of my research!
say:14:1421803012:1.source_cn: 芬克前辈的杰作启迪了我，把特殊的地底生态作为研究萨洛克...

say:15:1421803013:1.text: As archaeologists, it's important for us to study the history of both humanity and other life forms...
say:15:1421803013:1.source_cn: 身为考古学者，不仅要关心人类的历史，也要关心其他生命的...

say:16:1421803014:1.text: There's a jungle of giant mushrooms we want to visit. We thought about finding a local guide, but the Essail here aren't exactly fond of outsiders.
say:16:1421803014:1.source_cn: 我们听说地底有巨大伞状蕈菇组成的林地，本来想请当地人做...

choice_prompt:17:1421803014.text: There's a jungle of giant mushrooms we want to visit. We thought about finding a local guide, but the Essail here aren't exactly fond of outsiders.
choice_prompt:17:1421803014.source_cn: 我们听说地底有巨大伞状蕈菇组成的林地，本来想请当地人做向导，但这里的艾塞勒并不欢迎外人的到来。

say:18:1421803015:1.source_cn: 我的魔法师朋友，你还是这么热心且乐于助人！

say:0:1421804001:0.text: What amazing creatures might we come across there? I can't wait to find out!
say:0:1421804001:0.source_cn: 会见到什么有意思的生物呢？真让人兴奋！

say:2:1421807001:1.text: Melissa, a crazy idea just crossed my mind.
say:2:1421807001:1.source_cn: 梅丽莎，我有一个大胆的假设！

say:3:1421807002:1.text: Doesn't this scene remind you of something?
say:3:1421807002:1.source_cn: 你有没有觉得这里的景象似曾相识？

say:4:1421807003:1.text: Not everyone has an imagination as wild as yours...
say:4:1421807003:1.source_cn: 不是每个人都有和你一样丰富的想象力……

say:5:1421807004:1.text: Think about the manafleurs and glimmerblooms in the Dark Forest!
say:5:1421807004:1.source_cn: 想想薄暮丛林！那些巨大的魔花和荧荧花！

say:6:1421807005:1.text: Now, look at these giant mushrooms and those mushroom sprites scurrying around!
say:6:1421807005:1.source_cn: 再看看这些巨蕈和四处跑动的菇灵！

say:7:1421807006:1.text: According to Fink's book, manafleurs turn into glimmerblooms after two autumns...
say:7:1421807006:1.source_cn: 想想芬克前辈在书里写的内容，“魔花在经过两个落叶季后会...

say:9:1421807008:1.text: I've formed a bold hypothesis—the mushrooms and the mushroom sprites here have a similar relationship to that of the manafleurs and glimmerblooms in the Dark Forest! Polymorphism might exist here!
say:9:1421807008:1.source_cn: 我大胆推断，这里的巨蕈与菇灵的关系正如薄暮丛林的魔花与...

choice_prompt:10:1421807008.text: I've formed a bold hypothesis—the mushrooms and the mushroom sprites here have a similar relationship to that of the manafleurs and glimmerblooms in the Dark Forest! Polymorphism might exist here!
choice_prompt:10:1421807008.source_cn: 我大胆推断，这里的巨蕈与菇灵的关系正如薄暮丛林的魔花与荧荧花，体现了生物在不同阶段的多态性！

say:11:1421807009:1.source_cn: 这更进一步证实了我的猜测！

say:12:1421807010:1.text: These mushrooms are highly likely the juvenile form of those mushroom sprites!
say:12:1421807010:1.source_cn: 这些巨蕈极有可能是菇灵的幼年形态，经过一段时间的生长就...

say:13:1421807011:1.text: If my hypothesis is confirmed, I'll name my book... "The Study of Ancient Mushrooms," as a tribute of Fink!
say:13:1421807011:1.source_cn: 如果猜想能证实，我将致敬芬克前辈，这本书就叫……《古国...

say:14:1421807012:1.text: Magister, is there any potion that could speed up the growth of these mushrooms?
say:14:1421807012:1.male: Magister, is there any potion that could speed up the growth of these mushrooms?
say:14:1421807012:1.female: Magister, is there any potion that could speed up the growth of these mushrooms?

say:15:1421807013:1.source_cn: 我迫不及待想验证这伟大的发现了！

Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Dashroot Powder</style>
<style="highlight">Baby Mushrooms</style>
<style="highlight">Fresh Dew</style>
Mash the baby fuzzy mushrooms to extract the juice, then add fine dashroot powder and fresh dew. Simmer the mixture until small bubbles start to form on the surface.

say:1:1421813001:1.text: Wait, what? The potion withered the mushrooms!
say:1:1421813001:1.source_cn: 使用了速生魔药后，巨蕈竟然枯萎了！

say:2:1421813002:1.text: And what's going on with those mushroom sprites? They just suddenly charged at us...
say:2:1421813002:1.source_cn: 还有那些突然冒出来攻击我们的菇灵，这究竟是怎么回事……

say:4:1421813003:1.text: It's because you've disrupted the ecosystem here and destroyed their habitat!
say:4:1421813003:1.source_cn: 因为你们破坏了这里的生态！破坏了它们的家园！

say:5:1421813004:1.text: Are you all... from the surface? What do you want from us? *Whimper* Please don't hurt me...
say:5:1421813004:1.source_cn: 你们是……地表的人……你们有什么目的？呜……不要伤害我……

say:6:1421813005:1.text: Sorry, I meant no harm! I just wanted the mushrooms to grow faster!
say:6:1421813005:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我没有想伤害任何生物，我只想让它长得更快些！

say:7:1421813006:1.text: *Sob* The flowers I planted have withered too... Just look around...
say:7:1421813006:1.source_cn: 呜……我种的花也枯萎了……看看这周围……

say:0:1421814001:0.text: What's happening? Everything around is dying too!
say:0:1421814001:0.source_cn: 怎么周围也开始枯萎了！

say:3:1421815001:1.text: You're safe with us, young lady.
say:3:1421815001:1.source_cn: 小姑娘，我们不会伤害你！

say:4:1421815002:1.text: We're scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory, just here to conduct research.
say:4:1421815002:1.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的学者，来这里是为了学术研究！

say:5:1421815003:1.text: You won't find better people in this world than us.
say:5:1421815003:1.source_cn: 世界上可再找不出比我、梅丽莎还有这位魔法师<male>...
say:5:1421815003:1.male: You won't find better people in this world than us.
say:5:1421815003:1.female: You won't find better people in this world than us.

say:6:1421815004:1.text: But... you did this to the mushrooms... and my flowers...
say:6:1421815004:1.source_cn: 但是你们伤害了巨蕈……巨蕈现在变成了这样……我种的花也...

say:7:1421815005:1.text: We'll make this right—we swear it in the name of scholars! Our priority now is to figure out the cause of the withering.
say:7:1421815005:1.source_cn: 以学者之名发誓，我们肯定会负起责任的！现在当务之急是搞...

say:8:1421815006:1.text: You really didn't do it on purpose? I heard you mention a quickgrow potion... What did you make it with?
say:8:1421815006:1.source_cn: 你们真的不是故意的吗？我听你们提到了速生魔药……那是用...

choice_prompt:9:1421815006.text: You really didn't do it on purpose? I heard you mention a quickgrow potion... What did you make it with?
choice_prompt:9:1421815006.source_cn: 你们真的不是故意的吗？我听你们提到了速生魔药……那是用什么东西做的？

say:10:1421815007:1.text: Dashroot powder...? Dashroot... is that the name of a plant?
say:10:1421815007:1.source_cn: 疾根草粉末……？疾根草……是一种植物的名字？

say:11:1421815008:1.text: I'm curious about what it looks like! I know all the plants here, but I've never heard of one by that name...
say:11:1421815008:1.source_cn: 我想知道这种植物的样子！因为我很熟悉这里的植物，可我印...

say:12:1421815009:1.text: Hmm, how should I describe it? This is a tough one...
say:12:1421815009:1.source_cn: 疾根草的样子该怎么描述来着，这可有点为难我了……

say:13:1421815010:1.text: Gali, you can show her the book! "The Study of Ancient Biomes"!
say:13:1421815010:1.source_cn: 对了，伽利！让小姑娘看看那本书！《古国生物群落考》！

say:14:1421815011:1.text: There might be a section on dashroot in there.
say:14:1421815011:1.source_cn: 说不定里面有介绍疾根草的部分！

say:15:1421815012:1.text: Let me see... Found it! Page 814—Dashroot. It thrives in warm climates with plenty of water... There's even an illustration next to the text!
say:15:1421815012:1.source_cn: 我来找找……有了！《古国生物群落考》第814页，疾根草...

say:16:1421815013:1.text: So many things in this book are new to me! There are flowers, trees, vines, and mushrooms I've never seen before...
say:16:1421815013:1.source_cn: 这上面有好多我不认识的生物，有花草树木，也有藤蔓蕈菇……

say:17:1421815014:1.text: Is this the dashroot you mentioned? What a peculiar plant...
say:17:1421815014:1.source_cn: 你们说的疾根草长这样吗？真是奇特的植物……

say:18:1421815015:1.text: I'm absolutely sure it doesn't grow in Sal'thorin!
say:18:1421815015:1.source_cn: 可是，我十分确定，萨洛克兰并没有这样的植物生长！

choice_prompt:19:1421815015.text: I'm absolutely sure it doesn't grow in Sal'thorin!
choice_prompt:19:1421815015.source_cn: 可是，我十分确定，萨洛克兰并没有这样的植物生长！

say:20:1421815016:1.text: Let me take a look at the remaining dashroot powder!
say:20:1421815016:1.source_cn: 我想再看看剩余的疾根草粉末！

say:21:1421815017:1.text: This smell and texture... It's dyed nightshard ash!
say:21:1421815017:1.source_cn: 这种味道，这种质感……这是染过色的暗烬晶体灰烬！

say:22:1421815018:1.text: Nightshard is a type of crystal found in extremely dry volcanic regions, with strong water-absorbing properties...
say:22:1421815018:1.source_cn: 暗烬晶体生长在极为干燥的熔岩地区，吸水性极强……

say:23:1421815019:1.source_cn: 所以这里的巨蕈才会枯萎！

say:24:1421815020:1.source_cn: 这个奸商！我们去找他算账！

say:25:1421815021:1.text: We can do that later. Now, we should restore the jungle first.
say:25:1421815021:1.source_cn: 别急，当务之急是让这里恢复原样……

say:28:1421815023:1.source_cn: 您的意思是，速生魔药除了能加速植物生长外，也具备让枯萎...

say:30:1421815024:1.source_cn: 确实，那些研究草药学的魔法师养的植物少不了受到各种摧残……

say:31:1421815025:1.text: Anyway, dashroot is the key ingredient for the potion... Looks like we have to find it one way or another.
say:31:1421815025:1.source_cn: 想炼制速生魔药，疾根草是必不可少的……所以问题又回到找...

say:32:1421815026:1.text: I've never wanted to be a botanist this badly!
say:32:1421815026:1.source_cn: 我从来没有这么希望过自己是个植物学家！

say:33:1421815027:1.text: Ironhold Bay does have water and a warm climate, but it's a vast region...

Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Sturdy Dashroot</style>
<style="highlight">Baby Mushrooms</style>
<style="highlight">Fresh Dew</style>
Mash the baby fuzzy mushrooms to extract the juice, grind <style="highlight">sturdy dashroot</style> into a fine powder, and add fresh dew. Simmer the mixture until small bubbles start to form on the surface.
document:3:183:0.source_cn:
配料：
<style="highlight">茁壮的疾根草</style>
<style="highlight">稚嫩的茸茸伞菇</style>
<style="highlight">新鲜的露水</style>
将稚嫩的茸茸伞菇捣成汁液，将<style="highlight">茁壮的疾根草</style>研磨成颗粒极小的粉末，再加入新鲜露水熬煮至表面冒出细小泡沫。
